package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// PositionRepoPG implements PositionRepository.
type PositionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts a position.
func (r PositionRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, position domain.Position) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO "position" (name) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING`, position.Name)
	return err
}

// GetByID finds a position by id.
func (r PositionRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.Position, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, name FROM "position" WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var position domain.Position
	if err := row.Scan(&position.ID, &position.Name); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &position, nil
}

// GetByName finds a position by name.
func (r PositionRepoPG) GetByName(ctx context.Context, name string) (*domain.Position, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, name FROM "position" WHERE name=$1`, name)
	var position domain.Position
	if err := row.Scan(&position.ID, &position.Name); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &position, nil
}

// Update updates position name.
func (r PositionRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, position domain.Position) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE "position" SET name=$1 WHERE id=$2`, position.Name, position.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete removes a position by id.
func (r PositionRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM "position" WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns positions with pagination.
func (r PositionRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.PositionFilters) ([]domain.Position, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	whereClause := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		whereClause = "WHERE name ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx)
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := `SELECT count(*) FROM "position" ` + whereClause
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	query := `SELECT id, name FROM "position" ` + whereClause + ` ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT $` + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + ` OFFSET $` + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var positions []domain.Position
	for rows.Next() {
		var position domain.Position
		if err := rows.Scan(&position.ID, &position.Name); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		positions = append(positions, position)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return positions, total, nil
}

var _ repository.PositionRepository = (*PositionRepoPG)(nil)
